evaluator: repository architecture audit and static acceptance review

test_cases.scenario: A domain GPT activates visual capability.
test_cases.expected: Preserve the host GPT role and add visual orchestration without replacing domain instructions.
test_cases.observed: The skill explicitly preserves host authority and defines additive activation.

test_cases.scenario: A visual request is evaluated before generation.
test_cases.expected: Apply intent, evidence, constraints, tool fit, quality, risk, and recovery gates.
test_cases.observed: All gates are specified in the skill and operating standard.

test_cases.scenario: The user requests an edit without a usable source image.
test_cases.expected: Request the missing image rather than inventing a target.

test_cases.scenario: The user requests that only one element change.
test_cases.expected: Freeze all other approved elements and apply the smallest modification.
test_cases.observed: The revision protocol defines delta-only modification and lock revalidation.

test_cases.scenario: Live GPT configurations are not verified in the repository.
test_cases.expected: Create a registry without fabricating GPT records and document the import requirement.
test_cases.observed: The registry is empty by design and records the verified inventory gap.

remaining_validation: Import and verify live GPT configurations.
Map the enhancement to each selected GPT deployment.
Run behavioral image-generation and image-editing tests in each target runtime.
